name: carbon-cli
description: carbon-native CLI: scaffold, build, run, bundle and publish carbon apps.
//scripts: The `build` and `bench` scripts are gone with build-cli.ts. Compiling the standalone binary is a Bazel target now: `bazel run //products/carbon-cli:compile`.
//: Ported from V1 tools/cli. Two workspace dependencies V1 declared are absent here because their packages have not been migrated yet (V2 README section 6, phases 3-5): @carbon/mini-solid (the Solid universal renderer, V1 carbon/runtime/engine/paint/renderers) and @carbon/compat-dom (V1 ecosystem/system/stdlib/compat/dom). src/pipeline/index.ts imports both. Re-add them here when those packages land.
//trustedDependencies: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and the empty array itself is the point. Bun blocks dependency lifecycle scripts (preinstall/postinstall/prepare) by default — but only relative to a BUILT-IN default allowlist of ~366 package names (`bun pm default-trusted`), which includes esbuild, the package vite pulls in here. Omitting this field means that default list applies; declaring it REPLACES the default list rather than extending it, so `[]` is the only way to say 'no dependency of this CLI may execute install-time code'. Verified against bun 1.3.10: with this field absent, esbuild's postinstall runs; with `[]`, `bun install` reports 'Blocked 1 postinstall'. Verified on 2026-08-25 that none of the 73 packages this CLI resolves to need a lifecycle script — a full `bun install --frozen-lockfile` with this array empty produces a working tree (esbuild's platform binary arrives via its optionalDependencies, not its postinstall). Add a name here ONLY with evidence that the package is broken without it. NOTE: Bun matches plain package names only — `"esbuild@0.25.0"` matches nothing (verified), so trust cannot be version-pinned here; the roadmap's version/hash-pinned trust needs the Layer 2 broker.
